name: openline
description:
Openline is your AI frontdesk. It gives Claude a phone number and an email inbox. Calls, SMS, and emails all share the same memory. Use it to call and find your next lead or do a follow up. Let it answer your front desk, take messages, and tell callers what they need to know. Have it book a table at a restaurant, schedule an appointment, or confirm a reservation for you. Send reminders, chase a quote from a vendor, or check in with a customer after a conversation.
You can monitor your calls, emails and sms at https://staging.openline.scalarfield.io/site/dashboard
